# Callsun — PV Module Brand & Manufacturer

> Callsun designs, manufactures and tests standard and custom N-Type bifacial photovoltaic modules (180W–720W) for global B2B buyers: distributors, installers, EPCs, equipment manufacturers and project buyers.

Site: https://callsunenergy.com
Languages: English (default), German (/de/), Spanish (/es/)

## Products

Standard PV Modules (450W–720W, N-Type bifacial double-glass):
- [CN450W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn450w/): 450W, 22.52% module efficiency, 96 cells, 2.0mm double glass
- [CN580W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn580w/): 580W, 22.45% module efficiency, 144 cells
- [CN620W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn620w/): 620W, 22.95% module efficiency, 132 cells
- [CN720W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn720w/): 720W, 23.18% module efficiency, flagship format

Custom PV Modules (180W–215W, application-specific):
- [CN180W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn180w/): TwinCell anti-shading, RV/vehicle roofs, 12V
- [CN200W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn200w/): ultra-compact high watt density, balcony PV
- [CN210W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn210w/): dual-module parallel, 24V systems, marine/off-grid
- [CN215W](https://callsunenergy.com/products/cn215w/): 4-zone anti-shading, 12V, vehicle & marine

Localized product overviews: [/de/products/](https://callsunenergy.com/de/products/) · [/es/products/](https://callsunenergy.com/es/products/)

## Company

- Manufacturing: ~55,000 m², 4 bases, 180–720W module range
- Certifications: CE, RoHS, IEC 61215/61730, Intertek ETL Certificate of Compliance (2026)
- Quality: EL inspection, solar simulator testing, damp heat & thermal cycling, UV aging
- Markets: United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Japan, Vietnam, Indonesia, Australia, Brazil, Canada
- Contact: sales@callsunsolar.com · https://callsunenergy.com/contact/
